يختطوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَطُوا (yaḵtaṭū) /jax.ta.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# يُخْتَطَوْا (yuḵtaṭaw) /jux.ta.tˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
